title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SCHC Fragment::from_bytes All-1 payload uses raw wire bytes
description: In `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` `Fragment::from_bytes` (line 255), the All-1 fragment path extracts payload as `&data[2 + MIC_LENGTH..data.len() - 1]`. This uses raw wire bytes which are still shifted left by 1 bit (wire format), not recovered bytes. The regular fragment path correctly uses `&body[2..2 + content_len]` (recovered/shifted-right bytes from the body buffer). This means All-1 fragment payloads are corrupted after parsing - the bytes are in wire format, not original. Additionally, `data.len() - 1` skips the last wire byte which may drop needed data. Fix: the All-1 payload must also come from the recovered body buffer (after fixing the compile-error issue with local body reference).
